title: How to Reset Your API Key
content:
# How to Reset Your API Key

API keys are used to authenticate requests to the CloudDash REST API.

## When to Reset Your API Key

- If you suspect your key has been compromised.
- If a team member with API access leaves the organization.
- As part of your regular security key rotation policy.

## Steps to Reset

1. Log in to CloudDash with an **admin** account.
2. Navigate to **Settings > API > API Keys**.
3. Find the key you want to reset.
4. Click **Regenerate Key**.
5. Confirm the action in the dialog box.
6. **Copy the new key immediately** — it will only be shown once.
7. Update the key in all applications and scripts that use it.

## Important Notes

- The old key is **immediately invalidated** upon reset.
- All API requests using the old key will receive a `401 Unauthorized` response.
- You can have up to **5 active API keys** per account (Pro plan) or **20 keys** (Enterprise plan).
- Starter plan accounts have **1 API key** (read-only).
- API key activity is logged in **Settings > Security > Audit Log**.

## API Key Best Practices

- Never hardcode API keys in source code. Use environment variables.
- Rotate keys every 90 days.
- Use separate keys for different applications/environments.
- Set IP allowlists for API keys under **Settings > API > Security**.
